text:
maria: Heads up  Customer FinTrust is asking for our SOC 2 Type II PDF and a short control summary for their vendor risk review. NDA signed but it's set to expire in 5 days. They asked for a 10-day downloadable link. Can we do that? :wave:
tim: Security preference is to avoid long-lived downloads. Suggest 5 days max, watermark, and IP restriction if they have static IPs. Also redact internal emails/account ids from the copy.
sam: Ops here  default presign TTL is 24h, but we can generate up to 14 days. Command I use: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-sec/soc2/2025-02.pdf --expires-in 864000` (that is 10d). We log presign creation in the audit bucket.
natalie: Legal thoughts: quickest path = bridge letter confirming report still accurate and limiting use to the POC. If they need a PDF in-hand for their tooling, we can do a short presigned link with a signed bridge letter attached. Bridge text needs GC review but we can approve expedited.
maria: They explicitly said their tooling requires a downloaded file to ingest. They also don't accept view-only screen shares.
tim: If customer insists on 10d, require recipient full name and email for watermark + ask for IP ranges. Also request that they confirm they will not redistribute and will destroy copies after review (we can add as a clause in bridge).
s3-notify: [auto] presign_request_received: file=soc2/2025-02.pdf requested_by=maria requested_ttl=864000 request_id=pt-7789
sam: I'll stand by to create presign once we have recipient details and explicit approval from legal. If legal approves bridge, I'll include the bridge PDF in the same presigned object or a separate presigned link.
natalie: I'll draft bridge with this line: "Redwood confirms that the SOC 2 Type II report dated MM/DD/YYYY remains accurate as of issuance; access is granted solely for FinTrust's evaluation under the terms of the NDA and this bridge letter. Redistribution is prohibited." Will route to GC now.
maria: Great. I'll ask FinTrust for recipient name/email and IP ranges. Also confirm they accept watermark and 10-day TTL.
tim: One more ops note  we can revoke the presign by moving the object or changing ACLs but can't invalidate a presign URL otherwise. So keep TTL minimal.
sam: FYI we can also put the file behind CloudFront signed cookies tied to a short expiry and origin access identity, gives slightly more revocation options.
maria: Thanks all. I'll update when FinTrust replies. :pray:
